description: This file is a script written in JavaScript that analyzes other TypeScript source files to detect deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' calls. It imports TypeScript compiler APIs and utility functions to process source code, identify specific function calls, and output warnings or information based on the analysis.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Checks if the given expression is a property access expression with the property name 'registerHttpHandler', indicating a deprecated plugin API call.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses the content of a source file to locate lines where deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' calls are made.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Asynchronously runs the analysis to find deprecated plugin API calls and outputs related messages.
